rationale.NEW-001: Normative schema identity contradiction in the primary schema compatibility section. §23 self-identifies 16.1.0 while the header declares 16.3.0. Governor and Architect schema-version routing reads ptr_schema_version against the bound version; §23 directly instructs an incorrect version. Blocks promotion.
rationale.NEW-002: Normative compatibility claim in §23 asserts compatibility with v16.1.0 peer artifacts. All peer artifacts are v16.3.0. This asserts the package is compatible with a prior generation, not the current one. Blocks promotion.
rationale.NEW-003: core-package-manifest internal contradiction: required_core_generation = '16.3.0' and compatibility.cosyn_core_generation = '16.1.0'. A bolt-on reading cosyn_core_generation to validate the Core generation would receive a false value, potentially enabling wrong-version stack assembly. Blocks promotion.
rationale.NEW-010: D07 authorized repair incomplete. The D07 finding was blocking (D07 FAIL). The repair summary stated 'All operational hard-coded versioned bolt-on filenames removed or generalized' but fiction-pcr-protocol-v16.0.0.md was missed. This defect contributes to the D07 blocking status.
